label: S5 route frame entails the 5 schema of the route's NECESSARY_2 box (inference)
rule: Soundness of axiom 5 on Euclidean frames (axiom5_valid of the modal library), from the Euclidean conjunct of S5
meaning: Strength order registration: if the route's modal frame is reflexive and Euclidean (S5), the 5 schema 'whatever is possible is necessarily possible' (convergence formula 1 0 1 1) of the route's box is valid on it. Applies the existing modal-library theorem TruthCore.Modal.axiom5_valid to the frame's Euclidean condition. Establishes neither premise.
